issue_request: Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I change request to clarify SearchParameter derivation/conformance declaration by adding a Trial Use, ML 1 complies-with-canonical extension with canonical value type and contexts on SearchParameter, OperationDefinition, and relevant CapabilityStatement search/operation entries.

additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2025-03-24 confirm the 12-0-0 motion to define the extension in the Extension Pack. FHIR-46036 and FHIR-48876 explain the US Core SearchParameter derivation problem that prompted the issue but are outside this core-source decision. FHIR-48481 later added separate core guidance for derived SearchParameters and OperationDefinitions. A later Zulip thread shows that US Core application guidance for the extension remained uncertain, so inventing additional core prose here would be unsafe without a separate work-group decision.
